g.title: HR_CYCLEPARTICIPANT
g.text: Cycle Participant - Contains the participants, meaning people evaluated, of an appraisal cycle.
The identifier of the appraisal cycle record.
The Identifier of the Person record.
It is an auto-generated code for the participant in this cycle, consisting of the participant code and the appraisal cycle code.
It is an auto-generated name for the participant in this cycle, consisting of the participant name and the appraisal cycle name.
The Identifier of the Company Relationship record.
Indicates the date and time of creation

g.title: HR_CYCLEREVIEWERROLES
g.text: Cycle Reviewers Roles - This entity contains the evaluation roles that will be involved for the specific cycle. For example: Peer, Manager and so on.
The identifier of the appraisal cycle record.
This field contains the code for the appraisal cycle review role (automatically generated)
This field contains the description for the appraisal cycle review role (automatically generated)
The description of the appraisal cycle reviewer role.
This flag is used to specify that the review is anonymous.
Indicates the weighting as a percentage
Indicates if this is an additional reviewer role.
When multiple reviewers are allowed for the role, this field enables setting the minimum number of reviewers.
When multiple reviewers are allowed for the role, this field enables setting the maximum number of reviewers.
A number indicating the importance of the entity it relates to.
The identifier of appraisal role record.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation

Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRAISALFORM
g.text: Appraisal Form - This entity stores the appraisal form model or template that will be used during an evaluation.
The identifier of the Analytic record.
Whether a banner should be displayed at the top of the appraisal form.
The title shown in the banner
This field identifies the image to be used as a background.
This is a link to a Topic (article) that can be used as a Tutorial during the assessment.
In this field you can define a text resource for the Tutorial button.
Identify which assessment component is linked to this section
Indicates if individual appraisals based on this form template will also generate an individual payout.
When this flag is activated, the user can open the analytics page from the form.
When this flag is active, the Appraisal review header section, including the participant, reviewer and other review information will be visible.
When this flag is activated, the section containing the Component review scores will be visible.
This flag determines if the reviews by other reviewers are visible.
This flag determines if the reviews by additional reviewers are visible.
Show review comment in edit mode
This property is useful to turn on or off the properties: hide Emoji Picker, hide Comment Full Name, hide Comment Like and hide Comment Operations
When this flag is active, the Appraisal Review Header section shows detailed information.
This field indicates the report to be used for printing.
This flag indicates if the form is used for team rating.
This flag indicates if all review sections are collapsed.
This flag indicates if the Discussion Thread is Active
Number of Decimal Places of the Weight.
Indicates the date and time of creation

Indicates the IP address from which it was created

Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRAISALREVIEW
g.text: Appraisal Review - This entity stores the history of all individual appraisals.
The identifier of the appraisal cycle record.
Formatted name of an individual appraisal review.
Indicates the user group in charge for the appraisal.
In case of multiple appraisal reviews, this flag indicates that this is the primary review.
Indicates the person performing the appraisal.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
Is the reason, or milestone, to identify an intermediate appraisal review. Examples can be Mid year Review, Final Review.
The amount of the bonus target.
The bonus opportunity converted to System Currency.
The adjusted amount of the bonus target.
The Opportunity Adjusted converted to System Currency.
The percentage of the opportunity that will be paid.
The adjusted percentage of the opportunity that will be paid.
The amount that will be paid.
The payout converted to System Currency.
The adjusted amount that will be paid.
The adjusted payout converted to System Currency.
The Identifier of the Currency record.
